function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • 55 mph on rural interstates
• 45 mph on urban interstates
• 35 mph on highways with 2–3 lanes (unless posted otherwise)
• 25 mph in school zones during school hours | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.001‑545.004 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑seat Requirements** | • All occupants must wear seat belts (except for certain motorcycle riders).
• Children under 8 years or 4 ft 9 in tall must be in a child safety seat.
• Children 8–12 years or 4 ft 9 in–5 ft 4 in must use a booster seat. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless hands‑free).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Lower BAC limits for commercial drivers and drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021‑545.023 | | **Reckless Driving** | • Driving with a willful disregard for safety; includes speeding, tailgating, or dangerous maneuvers. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• Give right‑of‑way to emergency vehicles with flashing lights. | Texas Transportation Code §§ 545.021‑545.023 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or within 20 ft of a crosswalk.
• Pay attention to local ordinances for street cleaning, permit requirements, etc. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections required for certain vehicle types (e.g., commercial). | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) | | **Insurance Requirements** | • Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 for bodily injury per person, $60,000 for total bodily injury, $25,000 for property damage. | Texas Insurance Code § 151.001 | | **Common Penalties** | • Fines range from $50 to $1,000+ depending on offense.
• Points added to driving record (e.g., 3 points for DUI).
• License suspension or revocation. | Texas Transportation Code § 545.021 | --- ### How to Stay Updated 1. **Texas Department of Public Safety (DPS)** – Official website: [dps.texas.gov](https://www.dps.texas.gov/). 2. **Texas Transportation Code** – Accessible via the Texas Legislature’s website or legal databases. 3. **Local County Ordinances** – Check your county’s official website for specific parking, speed limit, or enforcement changes. 4. **Legal Aid & Law Firms** – For specific legal questions or if you’re facing charges, consult a licensed Texas attorney. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always obey posted speed limits** – they’re designed for safety, not convenience. - **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk or text while driving. - **Keep your vehicle in good condition** – regular maintenance reduces accidents. - **Stay alert for school buses** – they have special rules that can change quickly. - **Know your insurance limits** – under‑insurance can lead to serious financial consequences after an accident. --- If you need more detailed information on a specific law or want to check the latest updates, let me know!
